description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Cancellation of Licence issued to Trade Finance and Investments PLC.
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the cancellation of a finance business license for Trade Finance & Investments PLC due to its amalgamation with another company under the Finance Business Act. The content deals specifically with business regulation, licensing, and corporate restructuring in the financial sector, which falls under the Commercial classification (Type 6) for business and commercial matters. While it mentions the Governor of the Central Bank, it does so in his regulatory capacity regarding commercial licensing rather than detailing government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities.
